extracted.rawText:
Tom Alvarez
tom.alvarez@example.com | Phoenix, AZ
Tom Alvarez is a data engineer with 5 years of experience. Most recently, as
Data Engineer at Sonora Analytics (2023-2026), he built and maintained
Airflow-orchestrated ETL pipelines moving data through AWS S3 and Redshift, and
wrote most of the pipeline logic in Python with some Spark for larger batch
jobs, occasionally standing up small Node.js services to expose pipeline status
to internal tools. Before that, he was a Data Engineer II at Mesquite Retail
(2021-2023), also AWS-centric, working with Redshift and PostgreSQL, and doing
light distributed-systems work coordinating batch jobs across multiple regions.
He holds a B.S. in Information Systems from Arizona State University (2021).
Core skills: Python, Spark, Airflow, AWS, Redshift, PostgreSQL, with working
familiarity in distributed systems concepts and some exposure to Node.js.
